utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, how’s the repair drive going? Need any extra hands while I’m out running errands?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira — I could use an extra hand. If you’re free, could you swing by after your errands and help me sort the donations?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I can stop by after my errands and help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just help spread the word and bring any tools or spare parts you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll spread the word and see what tools or spare parts I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but only if we can sort out the timing and drop-off details first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so it’s not locked in yet — can you confirm when and where the drop-off is?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I can help out, I think; just tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — we still need someone to sort the donated tools and another hand to check the broken lamps. If you can take one of those, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can sort the donated tools — that sounds like the easier one for my forgetful head. Just point me to the boxes and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the repair drive details before we do anything. What exactly needs fixing, and when do you need it done?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m a bit fuzzy on the details. Let me check what still needs fixing and get back to you on the timing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — just let me know the specifics when you’ve checked, and I’ll help from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m in—what part of the repair drive do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane — could you help sort donations and greet folks as they drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I can sort donations and welcome people at the drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — if you’ve got a drill, some screws, and a hammer, bring those along. I’ll handle the list and point you to whatever needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll bring the drill, screws, and hammer. Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet, but I can check where the repair drive is being held and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I’d really appreciate that. Once you know, please let me know so I can plan around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll check and tell you as soon as I find the location.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout so far—folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you want, I can swing by later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, that’s great news! I’ll tell a few more neighbors and see if anyone can bring extra gloves or tape.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful—gloves and tape are exactly the sort of things they’re short on. I’ll stop by later and let you know if there’s anything else urgent.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly the loose porch steps and a couple of squeaky doors by the hall. If you want, I can point out the spots I noticed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, show me the spots you noticed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m thinking we can both help out with the repair drive and let the others know what’s needed. I’ll check in and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I can help spread the word once I hear what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll ask what parts and tools are needed, then I’ll pass it along so we stay coordinated.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — let’s get the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I can help quietly with the flyers and sorting donations.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Uli — thank you. I’ll put you on flyers and donation sorting, and we’ll keep it calm and simple.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is starting up soon—looks like folks are pitching in to get everything sorted. If you want, I can pass along the details when I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be kind of you, Tess. Just let me know the time and what I should bring, and I’ll plan on it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear the time and what they need folks to bring.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we’re still on for the repair drive, and I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for updates and try to make it there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Rey. I just need a hand sorting what’s left and maybe moving a few things.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can help sort what’s left and move a few things. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the main thing you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just a clear drop-off spot and the address for the repair drive, so I can keep track of where everything goes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can set that up—use my driveway at 18 Maple Street for the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you tell me what time the repair drive starts and what supplies are still needed?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not sure of the start time yet, but I can check on that. We still need basic repair supplies like tape, screwdrivers, and a few spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What changed again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We shifted the repair drive to Saturday afternoon and moved it to the community hall. I’ll send you the updated flyer so it’s easy to share.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — Saturday afternoon at the community hall. Thanks, send the flyer and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up steam—need me to swing by and see what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Ira—could you check if we still need a drill, a ladder, or any extra screws?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll swing by and see what’s still needed, and I’ll let you know if I spot the drill, ladder, or screws.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort the list and hand out jobs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a huge help, Leo — let’s sort the list by priority and then split up the jobs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little cautious about the repair drive—do we know the exact drop-off time and where everything should go?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t have the exact drop-off time yet—should I check and let you know? For now, we’re still figuring out the sorting and where each item should go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please check—I’d feel better having the exact time and a clear place for each item before I bring anything over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word fast about the repair drive—want me to put you down for helping out?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, put me down—I can help keep track of supplies and what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Cleo—I’ve got you down for supplies. I’ll let you know what’s still needed as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line up the repair drive around school pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be a big help, thanks. I’ll try to remember and send you the details as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks—just send them when you have a moment, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell — I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’d love your help. If you’ve heard of any homes that need work, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m happy to keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear. I don’t know of any right now, but I’ll let you know if I do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — I really appreciate that. Just send me anything you hear, and I’ll keep things moving.
